testcase.name: Scenario: Stage an import of freshly exported customization settings: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:309:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Stage an import of freshly exported customization settings ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon customization dialog is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Part 3D Model custom panel list is empty with no pending changes ✔ And the user has exported the current customization settings to a new XML file ✔ When the user clicks "Import" ✔ And the user selects that exported XML file and clicks "Open" ✔ Then the import dialog closes ✔ And the ribbon customization dialog remains open ✔ And the Part 3D Model target indicates a pending change ✔ And "OK", "Cancel", and "Apply" are available ✔ And the Part 3D Model custom panel list remains empty ✔ When the user clicks "Cancel" ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no custom panel appears on the active ribbon
